title: European Telescope Discovers ‘Einstein Ring’ in Nearby Galaxy
speaker: VOA Learning English

sentences.en: Scientists say Europe’s Euclid space telescope has discovered a bright ring of light circling a nearby galaxy .
sentences.zh: 科学家们说欧洲的欧几里德太空望远镜 发现了一个光环环环环绕着附近的星系

sentences.en: The observed light is known as an Einstein ring.
sentences.zh: 观测到的光线被称为爱因斯坦环。

sentences.en: Researchers have estimated the ring encircles a galaxy 590 million light years away from Earth.
sentences.zh: 研究人员估计环环环绕着 离地球5亿9千万光年的银河系

sentences.en: A light year is the distance light travels in a year – about 9.5 trillion kilometers.
sentences.zh: 光年是一年中的距离,大约9.5万亿公里。

sentences.en: Astronomers have long known about the galaxy where the ring was discovered.
sentences.zh: 天文学家早就知道 星系的星系 环被发现

sentences.en: So, they were surprised that the bright ring had not been identified before.
sentences.zh: 所以,他们惊讶地发现 明亮的戒指之前没有被确认。

sentences.en: It was discovered in a well-studied galaxy called NGC 6505.
sentences.zh: 它被发现在一个研究良好的星系 叫做NGC6505。

sentences.en: It is in the constellation – a group of stars – named Draco.
sentences.zh: 星座里有一群星星 叫做德拉科

sentences.en: Einstein rings are rare. They form when light from a more distant galaxy bends around a closer galaxy.
sentences.zh: 爱因斯坦环是稀有的。它们形成时,从更遥远的银河系发出的光向更近的星系倾斜。

sentences.en: The nearer galaxy appears to have a circle of light, or a halo, around it.
sentences.zh: 银河系附近似乎有光环 或光环环环绕它

sentences.en: The Einstein ring gets its name from physicist Albert Einstein.
sentences.zh: 爱因斯坦戒指的名字来自物理学家阿尔伯特·爱因斯坦

sentences.en: Einstein predicted that light would bend around extremely massive objects in space.
sentences.zh: 爱因斯坦预言 光线会弯曲 围绕太空中巨大的物体。

sentences.en: This is called “gravitational lensing.” The American space agency NASA explains that as light passes through a gravitational lens , “it may take different paths, producing multiple images of the same object.” In this way, gravity itself acts as a lens, magnifying and distorting space and time in a way that is similar to an optical lens like those in eyeglasses or contact lenses.
sentences.zh: 这被称为“引力透镜 ” 。 美国航天局(NASA)解释道,当光线通过引力透镜时,“它可能走不同的道路,产生同一物体的多重图像 ” 。 这样,引力本身作为透镜、放大和扭曲空间和时间的作用方式与眼镜或隐形镜相似。

sentences.en: Gravitational lenses permit telescopes like Euclid to observe more distant and less-bright objects.
sentences.zh: 引力镜使欧几里德这样的望远镜能够观测更遥远和不太亮的物体。

sentences.en: In the latest project, researchers from Germany’s Max Planck Institute for Astrophysics used data from Euclid to create a computer model to discover the Einstein ring.
sentences.zh: 在最新的项目中,德国马克斯·普朗克天体物理学研究所的研究人员利用欧几里德的数据创建了一个计算机模型来发现爱因斯坦环。

sentences.en: The Euclid space telescope is operated by the European Space Agency (ESA).
sentences.zh: 欧几里德空间望远镜由欧洲空间局(欧空局)运营。

sentences.en: In 2023, it launched on a six-year mission that ESA officials have said aims to study the mysteries of dark matter and dark energy across the universe.
sentences.zh: 2023年,欧空局官员说,它开展了为期六年的飞行任务,目的是研究整个宇宙暗物质和暗能量的奥秘。

sentences.en: Astronomers at the Max Planck Institute are leading the research.
sentences.zh: 马克斯·普朗克研究所的天文学家正在领导研究。

sentences.en: In a statement, the organization said the first sign that the Einstein ring existed came during testing right after Euclid was deployed.
sentences.zh: 该组织在一份声明中说,在欧几里德被部署后,在试验期间,第一个迹象表明爱因斯坦环的存在。

sentences.en: A team member, Bruno Altieri, was looking over early data collected by Euclid.
sentences.zh: 一名小组成员Bruno Altieri正在调查欧几里德收集的早期数据。

sentences.en: “Even from that first observation, I could see it,” Altieri said in a statement. “But after Euclid made more observations of the area, we could see a perfect Einstein ring.
sentences.zh: 阿尔蒂埃里在一项声明中说,“即使从最初的观察中,我也能看出这一点。” 但是,在欧几里德对该地区做了更多的观察之后,我们可以看到完美的爱因斯坦环。

sentences.en: For me, with a lifelong interest in gravitational lensing, that was amazing.” The scientists said the more distant galaxy involved in the method is about 4.4 billion light years away from Earth.
sentences.zh: 对我来说,对于引力透镜的终身兴趣,这是惊人的。” 科学家们说,这个方法所涉及的距离较远的星系离地球约44亿光年。

sentences.en: They noted that the more distant galaxy had never been observed before and does not have a name.
sentences.zh: 他们指出,更远的星系以前从未观测过,也没有名字。

sentences.en: Altieri’s team recently reported the findings in a study in the publication Astronomy and Astrophysics .
sentences.zh: Altieri小组最近报告了在出版物《天文和天体物理学》中进行的一项研究的结果。

sentences.en: Conor O’Riordan is another team member from the Max Planck Institute and was the lead writer of the study.
sentences.zh: Conor O'Riordan是马克斯·普朗克研究所的另一个小组成员,是这项研究的主要作者。

sentences.en: He said, “All strong lenses are special, because they're so rare, and they're incredibly useful scientifically.
sentences.zh: 他说,“所有强镜都是特别的, 因为它们非常罕见, 而且它们科学上是非常有用的。

sentences.en: This one is particularly special, because it’s so close to Earth and the alignment makes it very beautiful.” O’Riordan added that the researchers used the latest gravitational lensing methods developed at the institute.
sentences.zh: 这个特别特别,因为它离地球如此近,而且对齐使地球变得非常美丽。 欧里安补充说,研究人员使用了研究所开发的最新引力透镜方法。

sentences.en: This permitted them to model the light of the ring. “We even had to look at some of the raw data to better understand how the detector works.”
sentences.zh: 这使得它们能够模拟环的光线。 “我们甚至不得不查看一些原始数据,以便更好地了解探测器是如何工作的。”

sentences.en: O’Riordan said the team’s modeling operations were just the first step in studying the newly discovered Einstein ring.
sentences.zh: O'Riordan说,该团队的建模行动只是研究新发现的爱因斯坦环的第一步。

sentences.en: He said the group plans to use the ring to also study “dark matter substructures” within the lensing galaxy.
sentences.zh: 他说小组计划使用环子研究透镜星系内的“暗物质子结构”。

sentences.en: O’Riordan predicted, “Euclid is going to revolutionize the field, with all this data we've never had before.” I’m Bryan Lynn.
sentences.zh: 奥里奥丹预测说, “ 欧几里德将用我们从未掌握过的所有数据来改变这个领域。 ”我是布莱恩·林恩。

sentences.en: Bryan Lynn wrote this story for VOA Learning English, based on reports from The Associated Press, the Max Planck Institute, the European Space Agency and NASA.
sentences.zh: Bryan Lynn为VOA学习英语撰写了这个故事, 其依据是美联社、Max Planck研究所、欧洲航天局和美国航天局的报告。
